title: On the Mysteries (Taylor Translation)
author: Iamblichus
description: Thomas Taylor's translation of Iamblichus's defence of sacred ritual and theurgy. The work examines divination, divine presence and the soul's relationship with higher realities within late antique Neoplatonic philosophy.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection.
rights: Thomas Taylor's translation was published in 1821; public domain in the USA as a pre-1929 publication. Rights can vary by country.
